 % Spectral simulation Chan180_S4_B3
 % 
 % Papers: 
 % 
 % 1. A.W. Vreman and J.G.M. Kuerten, Comparison of DNS databases of turbulent 
 %    channel flow at Re_tau=180, Phys. Fluids 26, 015102 (2014). 
 % 2. A.W. Vreman and J.G.M. Kuerten, Statistics of spatial derivatives of 
 %    velocity and pressure in turbulent channel flow, Phys. Fluids 26, 
 %    085103 (2014).
 % 3. A.W. Vreman and J.G.M. Kuerten, A third-order multistep time 
 %    discretization for a Cheyshev tau spectral method. 
 % 
 % The simulations "*_B3" were performed with a modified spectral method: 
 %  - The time discretization scheme was replaced by the third-order time 
 %    discretization scheme B3, defined in Ref. 3 mentioned above. 
 %  - The right-hand side of the pressure Poisson equation was -u_{i,k}u_{k,i}
 %    (instead of minus the divergence of the rotational form of the
 %    convective terms). Thus the Laplacian of the pressure is zero to 
 %    machine precision at the walls, which leads to improved behaviour of  
 %    higher-order moments of pressure derivatives in the first few grid 
 %    points of the wall. The pressure Poisson equation was used for 
 %    post-processing only. 
 %
 % Parameters:     H=1; nu=1/180; forcing=1
 % Domain:         4pi x  2  x 2pi/3
 % Resolution:     576 x 577 x 385
 % Averaging time: 100
 % Computed u_tau: 0.99970
 %
 % Creation date of the columns in this datafile: 3 February 2015
 %
 % Data format:    288 rows, 88 columns
 % 
 % Description of columns:
 %
 % Column   1:  y+ (=180*y)
 %
 % Profiles of the FLATNESS of (the fluctuation of):
 % 
 % Column   2:  u1   (streamwise velocity)
 % Column   3:  u2   (normal velocity)
 % Column   4:  u3   (spanwise velocity)
 % Column   5:  p    (pressure)

 % Column   7:  du1/dx2
 % Column   8:  du1/dx3
 % Column   9:  du2/dx1
 % Column  10:  du2/dx2
 % Column  11:  du2/dx3
 % Column  12:  du3/dx1
 % Column  13:  du3/dx2
 % Column  14:  du3/dx3
 % Column  15:  dp/dx1 -1
 % Column  16:  dp/dx2
 % Column  17:  dp/dx3
 % Column  18:  (du1/dx2 + du2/dx1)/2, (s12,  strain rate component)
 % Column  19:  (du1/dx3 + du3/dx1)/2, (s13,  strain rate component)
 % Column  20:  (du2/dx3 + du3/dx2)/2, (s23,  strain rate component)
 % Column  21:  du3/dx2 - du2/dx3      (vor1, streamwise vorticity)
 % Column  22:  du1/dx3 - du3/dx1      (vor2, normal vorticity)
 % Column  23:  du2/dx1 - du1/dx2      (vor3, streamwise vorticity)
 %
 % Column  24:  d2u1/dx1dx1  (second-order derivative of streamwise velocity)
 % Column  25:  d2u1/dx2dx2

 % Column  28:  d2u1/dx1dx3

 % Column  40:  d2u3/dx1dx3
 % Column  41:  d2u3/dx2dx3

 % Column  43:  d2p/dx2dx2
 % Column  44:  d2p/dx3dx3
 % Column  45:  d2p/dx1dx2
 % Column  46:  d2p/dx1dx3

 % Column  48:  Laplacian(u1)
 % Column  49:  Laplacian(u2)
 % Column  50:  Laplacian(u3)
 % Column  51:  Laplacian(p)

 % Column  52:  u1*u1
 % Column  53:  u2*u2

 % Column  55:  u1*u2

 % Column  57:  u2*u3 
 % Column  58:  u1^2+u2^2+u3^2

 % Column  60:  vor1^2+vor2^2+vor3^2
